fields.description: Groq, Anthropic, or whichever credential you want every site to answer with.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: Blank falls back to the credential's own default model.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: Answers when the first one is rate limited or down.
fields.label: Fallback Provider

fields.description: Off means the choice here wins everywhere, which is the point of setting it here.
fields.label: Let a site override the model

fields.description: Off means each site keeps its own key and only the provider and model come from here. Turn on only for sites you operate.
fields.label: Send the API key to sites

fields.description: Prompts and responses are the client's own business data. Off by default.
fields.label: Record prompts and responses

fields.description: 0 keeps them forever. Tokens and cost are what billing runs on.
fields.label: Keep call records for (days)

fields.description: Turns the /account portal on. With this off, keys can only be issued here by hand.
fields.label: Let customers sign up themselves

fields.description: A cap, so one sign-up cannot mint trial keys in a loop.
fields.label: Sites one account may register

fields.description: Off means the account page keeps showing seats and hides the calculator.
fields.label: Sell Credits

fields.description: The calculator rounds a purchase to this. 1000 matches how the slabs read.
fields.label: Buy In Multiples Of

fields.description: How long a purchase lasts. Every new purchase extends the whole balance.
fields.label: Validity (Months)

fields.description: Shown on the calculator. The invoice itself is worked out by india_compliance.
fields.label: Tax Percent

fields.description: The site starts warning below this. Zero still answers until the balance runs out.
fields.label: Low Balance Warning At

fields.description: Cheaper the more they buy. Rows are read in order; the last row with 0 covers the rest.
fields.label: Credit Slabs

fields.description: Margin on provider cost. Used when no bands are set below.
fields.label: Markup %

fields.description: Rates are stored in INR. This only converts a row still marked USD, so a provider's dollar price sheet can be typed in without doing the sums by hand.
fields.label: USD to INR (entry helper)

fields.description: Off: keys are issued by hand. Key: the site must present the shared code below. Approval: the site enrols but arrives disabled until you enable it. Open: anyone who installs the app is enrolled.
fields.label: Enrolment Mode

fields.description: One short code you give customers. Beats making them log into a portal to copy a 43 character key.
fields.label: Enrolment Code

fields.description: Granted on enrolment. Zero means a new site must buy before it can ask anything, which is what makes open enrolment safe to leave on.
fields.label: Trial Credits

fields.description: Per source address. A cheap brake on someone scripting sign-ups.
fields.label: Enrolments Per Hour

fields.description: Off means a payment still credits the wallet but no Sales Invoice is raised.
fields.label: Issue Invoices

fields.description: The seller. Its GSTIN decides which side of the state line every invoice falls on.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: The service line. Created on first use with SAC 997331 if left blank.
fields.label: Credit Item

fields.description: Off leaves each invoice as a draft for someone to check before it goes out.
fields.label: Submit Automatically

fields.description: GST caps an invoice number at 16 characters, so the default ACC-SINV-.YYYY.- series is too long to use.
fields.label: Invoice Naming Series

fields.description: Sites send us the conversation and we call the model. Their site never holds a provider, a model name or a key. Switch this off and each site calls a provider itself with its own key.
fields.label: Answer On Behalf Of Sites
